export.fieldsHint: The signature covers exactly the selected columns and filters, so trimming the file afterwards breaks verification.
export.filtersApplied: Actor and severity filters from the events tab apply to the export.

denials.title: RBAC denials
denials.description: Every request refused by a role permission or an ABAC policy. Repeats of the same user, permission and route within a minute are recorded once.

ai.actionsDescription: Each AI action from preview through consent to execution or denial. Payloads are redacted before they reach this page.
ai.toolsDescription: Read-only tool calls, denials and sanitized outputs, redacted the same way.
ai.recordMissing: The action record is gone (its conversation was deleted); only the audit events remain.
ai.loadFailed: The AI trail could not be loaded

retention.title: Retention by severity
retention.description: How long audit events of each severity are kept. A severity without its own value follows the default.
retention.saveFailed: Audit retention could not be saved
retention.defaultHint: The default is the audit retention set under Settings → Data retention.
retention.chainNote: Pruning leaves a sealed tombstone over each removed run of events, so the hash chain still verifies across the gap.
retention.loadFailed: The retention policy could not be loaded

verify.title: Verify audit integrity
verify.description: Walks the whole hash chain and checks every sealed row. On a large trail this can take a while.
verify.incomplete: Verified with unsealed or unchecked rows
verify.keyMissing: No HMAC key is configured, so sealed rows cannot be checked.
verify.truncated: Only the first {{count}} rows were checked.
verify.noAnchors: The chain passes through no instance restore.
